title: Gentle Lumbar Area Work
summary: Broad, gentle movements are applied to the muscles of the lower back without deep pressure.
goal: Provide comfortable, relaxing contact to the lower back as part of a general massage.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of gentle lumbar area work without text labels.
startingPosition: The person lies face down. Use support under the abdomen or lower legs if needed for comfort.
instructions: Place the broad surface of the palms over the lower-back muscles.
Use slow strokes upward and slightly outward.
Add small palm circles only over soft tissue.
Keep the pressure light to moderate.
Avoid strong vertical pressure and painful areas.
direction: Upward and outward over the soft tissues of the lower back.
tips: Reduce pressure or stop immediately if discomfort appears.
mistakes: Strong pressure directly over the spinal midline.
warning: Do not perform this technique over acute pain, recent injury, significant inflammation, damaged skin, or when touch increases symptoms. Seek qualified professional advice when uncertain.
